title: Single-Molecule Microscopy Meets Molecular Dynamics Simulations for Characterizing the Molecular Action of Proteins on DNA and in Liquid Condensates.
one_liner_zh: 该综述结合单分子荧光显微镜与分子动力学模拟，系统阐述DNA结合蛋白（以p53为模型）在DNA上的靶标搜索与结合机制，并延伸至液-液相分离凝聚体中的动态行为，虽非聚焦TF-DNA特异性结合建模，但方法可迁移且涉及蛋白-DNA互作动态机理。
abstract: DNA-binding proteins trigger various cellular functions and determine cellular fate. Before performing functions such as transcription, DNA repair, and DNA recombination, DNA-binding proteins need to search for and bind to their target sites in genomic DNA. Under evolutionary pressure, DNA-binding proteins have gained accurate and rapid target search and binding strategies that combine three-dimensional search in solution, one-dimensional sliding along DNA, hopping and jumping on DNA, and intersegmental transfer between two DNA molecules. These mechanisms can be achieved by the unique structural and dynamic properties of these proteins. Single-molecule fluorescence microscopy and molecular dynamics simulations have characterized the molecular actions of DNA-binding proteins in detail. Furthermore, these methodologies have begun to characterize liquid condensates induced by liquid-liquid phase separation, e.g., molecular principles of uptake and dynamics in droplets. This review discusses the molecular action of DNA-binding proteins on DNA and in liquid condensate based on the latest studies that mainly focused on the model protein p53.
abstract_zh: DNA结合蛋白触发多种细胞功能并决定细胞命运。在执行转录、DNA修复及DNA重组等功能之前，DNA结合蛋白需在基因组DNA中搜索并与其靶位点结合。在进化压力下，DNA结合蛋白已获得精确且快速的靶标搜索与结合策略，这些策略结合了溶液中的三维搜索、沿DNA的一维滑动、在DNA上的跳跃与弹跳，以及两条DNA分子间的段间转移。这些机制可通过这些蛋白独特的结构与动态特性实现。单分子荧光显微镜和分子动力学模拟已详细表征了DNA结合蛋白的分子行为。此外，这些方法已开始表征由液-液相分离诱导的液体凝聚体，例如液滴中摄取与动态的分子原理。本综述基于主要聚焦于模型蛋白p53的最新研究，探讨了DNA结合蛋白在DNA上及液体凝聚体中的分子作用。
